append.detail: SLICE 1 SHIPPED 2026-10-20: modules/crm/index.ts (server) and modules/crm/client.ts (client-safe) are the CRM module's public API; the seven pages and components that reached into components/spaces/crm/* now import the barrel; eslint.config.mjs has a no-restricted-imports boundary that rejects components/spaces/crm/* and any modules/<app>/<file> except /client from outside the module.
